managedIde.title: Managed IDE Dev Mode
managedIde.description: Inspect the Pro IDE broker, simulate permissions, and develop Pro IDE plugins from their folders. It lasts until you switch it off or quit, and nothing here is saved.
managedIde.desktopOnly: Dev Mode works with this desktop's own Pro IDE.
managedIde.off: Off. Switch it on to record the broker trace, simulate permissions, and trust plugin folders.
managedIde.enterFailed: Could not turn on Dev Mode: {message}
managedIde.leaveFailed: Could not turn off Dev Mode: {message}
managedIde.leftDisabled: {count, plural, one {Disabled # plugin that was} other {Disabled # plugins that were}} trusted only for this Dev Mode session

trace.payloadsHint: Off, only the shape of each payload is kept. On, values are kept too, and redacted before they are shown here.
trace.empty: No broker traffic yet. Open the Pro IDE and use a plugin.

simulation.intro: Decide a permission for one plugin, for this Dev Mode session only. Allow and Deny answer without asking; Ask always asks.
simulation.noPlugins: No installed plugin targets the Pro IDE.

folders.intro: Plugins installed from these folders are trusted while Dev Mode is on (local development signing). With Watch plugin folders on, an edit reinstalls the plugin and reloads it with a temporary Pro IDE proxy.

watch.title: Watch plugin folders
watch.description: Reload a plugin in place when its files change on disk, without running the CLI.
watch.watching: Watching {count, plural, =0 {no plugins} one {# plugin} other {# plugins}}
watch.desktopOnly: Watching plugin folders needs the Cognia desktop app.
watch.empty: No plugin is eligible to watch. Install one from a local folder, or run `cognia plugin dev`.

reason.needs-build: Needs a build first. The app has no compiler, so editing the source produces no new artifact. Use `cognia plugin dev`, which builds and installs before reloading.
reason.not-local-source: Installed from a package, so there is no source folder on disk to watch.
reason.desktop-required: Only the desktop app can watch the filesystem.
